And at this time, the country of Kabul, from the region of India, was subjugated to the Arabs.
And Abu Ja'far imposed tributes upon all the peoples,
and he doubled the taxes of the Christians.
And in the year 1076
(1076 of the Greeks,
765 of our Lord?), there was an exceedingly severe earthquake in the land of Khorasan,
and a mountain moved from its place about three miles.
And because it was earth, it was scattered.
And in the year 1080
[1080], certain Magians who were in Persia rebelled against the Arabs,
and they set up a leader for themselves.
And a force of the Arabs went against them,
and the Arabs were defeated.
And again the Magians took courage to establish a kingdom for themselves,
and the Arabs came down against them with a much stronger force,
and the Magians were defeated.
And about forty thousand of them fell,
and their leader was killed.
And in the same year, the Arabs went up in wrath against the valley of Germanicia, which is Mar'ash,
because they had heard that they had allegedly become spies for the Romans.
And they exiled the inhabitants of the country,
and they carried them away and settled them in the region of Ramla.
And likewise also the people of Samosata.
And at this time, the Berbers, the inhabitants of Africa, rebelled,
and they killed the Arabs and the Persians.
And Yazid, the commander of the army, went against them and defeated them,
and about thirty thousand of the Berbers fell.
And in the same year 1080
a certain woman was found in the land of the Bukharians who had never taken nourishment,
nor had she sucked milk,
nor had she been in need of drink.
And al-Mahdi, the son of the king, heard about her,
and he sent and brought her to Baghdad.
And he tested the matter,
and it was found that the matter, which was beyond nature, was true.
And in the year 1083
[1083], Abu Ja'far built a city beside Callinicus,
and he called it al-Rafiqa,
such that no one has seen the like of the craftsmanship of its gates.
These very gates,
when I, the feeble one, was entrusted with the pastorship of Beroea,
they brought to Aleppo:
two large double gates entirely of iron,
and they mounted them on the Gate of Qinnasrin;
and two double gates that were smaller than these,
they did not manage to set up,
because immediately the Mongols (Moghuls) captured Aleppo,
and they demolished its walls
and cut down its gates.
